summary.headline: Astrology and Divine Foreknowledge
summary.text: Theological defense of astrology argues that the stars act by divinely foreknown natural properties rather than as conscious or efficient causes. It cites the bishop of Patara, John of Damascus, Anastasius of Sinai, Constantine and Irene, and examples involving the Cross, an eclipse, and the Nativity star, while comparing stellar influence with biological generation obstructed by bodily conditions.
